title: Assessment of Progranulin and FAM19A5 Protein Blood Levels in Metabolic Syndrome
brief_summary: The main objective of the study is to assess the serum levels of progranulin and FAM19A5 protein in adults with metabolic syndrome.
study_population: 40 people (women and men) with metabolic syndrome (study group) and 40 people (women and men) without metabolic syndrome (control group).
